a: Ammemar amar: af eno memaet chelek bechora, shenneemar: "veyalda lo banim" – ad sheyyehe ben bishat leda.
Rav shezvi amar: af eno nimmol lishmona, deamar kera: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar", "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol" – ad sheyyehe zachar mishsheat leda.
Rav sherevya amar: af en immo temea leda, deamar kera: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vetama shivat yamim" – ad sheyyehe zachar mishsheat leda.
Metivi: hammappelet tumetum veanderoginos – teshev lezachar velinkeva. teyuveteh derav sherevya! teyuveta.
Lema tehve teyuveta derav shezvi?
Tanna sappoke mesappeka leh, ulechumera.
I hachi, "teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda" mibbee leh! kashya.
Amar rava, tanya kevoteh derabbi amme: "ben" – velo tumetum, "bechor" – velo safek.
Bishlama "ben" velo tumetum – kidrabbi amme. ella "bechor" velo safek – leappoke may?
Leappoke middedaresh rava, dedaresh rava: shete nashim sheyyaldu shene zecharim bemachave, kotvin hareshaa ze laze.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava, veha shelach ravin: davar ze shaalti lechol rabbotay velo amru li davar, beram kach amru mishshum rabbi yannay: hukkeru, ulevassof nitarvu – kotvin hareshaa ze laze. lo hukkeru – en kotvin hareshaa ze laze!

Hadar oki rava amora aleh, uderash: devarim sheamarti lachem – taut hen beyadi, beram kach amru mishshum rabbi yannay: hukkeru ulevassof nitarvu – kotvin hareshaa ze leze, lo hukkeru – en kotvin hareshaa ze laze.
Shelachu leh bene akra deagma lishmuel, yelammedenu rabbenu: hayu muchezakin baze – shehu bechor, veamar aviv al acher "bechor hu", mahu? shelach lehu: kotvin hareshaa
b: Ze laze.
Ma nafshach? i kerabbanan sevira leh, lishlach lehu kerabbanan; i kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, lishlach lehu kerabbi yehuda!
Mesappeka leh i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbanan.
May hi? detanya: "yakkir", yakkirennu laacherim.

Mikkan amar rabbi yehuda: neeman adam lomar: "ze beni bechor". ucheshem shenneeman adam lomar "ze beni bechor", kach neeman adam lomar "ze ben gerusha" veze ben chalutza". vachachamim omrim: eno neeman.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: bishlama lerabbi yehuda – hayeynu dichtiv: "yakkir". ella lerabbanan, "yakkir" lema li?
Bitzrich hekkera.
Lemay hilcheta, lemitteva lo pi shenayim? lo yehe ella acher – illu bae lemitteva leh bemattana, mi la yahev leh?!
La tzericha, binchasim shennaflu lo leachar mikkan.
Ulerabbi meir, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam, "yakkir" lema li?
Binchasim shennaflu lo keshehu goses.
Tanu rabbanan: hayu muchezakin bo shehu bechor, veamar aviv al acher shehu bechor – neeman. hayu muchezakin bo sheeno bechor, veamar aviv: bechor hu – eno neeman.
Resha rabbi yehuda, vesefa rabbanan.
Amar rabbi yochanan: amar "beni hu", vechazar veamar "avdi hu" – eno neeman. "avdi hu", vechazar veamar "beni hu" – neeman, dimshammesh li keavda kaamar.
Vechillufeh abbet hammeches – haya over al bet hammeches veamar "beni hu", vechazar veamar "avdi hu" – neeman. amar "avdi hu", vechazar veamar "beni hu" – eno neeman.
Metivi: haya meshammesho keven, uva veamar "beni hu", vechazar veamar "avdi hu" – eno neeman. haya meshammesho keeved, uva veamar "avdi hu", vechazar veamar "beni hu" – eno neeman.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hatam, dekaru leh: "avda metzar mea". may "metzar mea"? metzar avda mea zuze.
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama, haomer lachavero: "avdi ganavta", vehu omer: "lo ganavti". "ma tivo etzlecha?" "atta mecharto li;

a: Atta netatto li bemattana. retzoncha hishshava vetol?" venishba – eno yachol lachzor bo.
May ka mashma lan? tenena, amar lo: "neeman alay abba"; "neeman alay avicha"; "neemanin alay shelosha roe vakar" – rabbi meir omer: yachol lachazor bo, vachachamim omrim: eno yachol lachazor bo!
Ha ka mashma lan – divetten lach" machloket, vahalacha kedivre chachamim.
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama, halacha: govin min haavadim. verav nachman amar: en govin.
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama, halacha: shelishi besheni – kasher. rava amar: af berishon.
Mar bar rav ashe achshar beabba deabba; velet hilcheta kemar bar rav ashe.
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama: haya yodea lo beedut karka ad shello nistamme, venistamme – pasul.

Ushemuel amar: kasher, efshar dimchavven mitzranaha. aval gelima – la. verav sheshet amar: afillu gelima, efshar dimchavven middat orko umiddat rochbo. aval nesacha – la. verav pappa amar: afillu nesacha, efshar dimchavven middat mishkelotav.
Metivi: haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano, venaasa chatano; pikkeach, venitcharesh; pitteach, venistamme; shafuy, venishtatta – pasul.

Aval haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano, venaasa chatano umeta bitto; pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach; pitteach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach; shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa – kasher.
Ze hakkelal: kol shettechillato o sofo befaslut – pasul, techillato vesofo bechashrut – kasher.
b: Teyuveta dechullehu! teyuveta.
Shelach rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama: haomer al tinok ben habbanim – neeman. verabbi yochanan amar: eno neeman.
May kaamar? amar abbaye: hachi kaamar, haomer al tinok ben habbanim: "yirash kol nechasay" – neeman, kerabbi yochanan ben beroka. verabbi yochanan amar: eno neeman, kerabbanan.
Matkef la rava: hay "neeman" veeno neeman"?! "yirash" velo yirash" mibbaya leh!
Ella amar rava: hachi kaamar, haomer al tinok ben habbanim: "bechor hu" – neeman, kerabbi yehuda. verabbi yochanan amar: eno neeman, kerabbanan.
Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama: haomer "tittol ishti keechad min habbanim" – notelet keechad min habbanim. amar rava: uvinchasim shel achshav, uvevanim habbain leachar mikkan.

Shelach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama: hammotzi shetar chov al chavero; malve omer: lo nifrati kelum, velove omer: parati mechetza, vehaedim meidin sheppara kullo – hare ze nishba, vegove mechetza minnechasim bene chorin; aval mimmeshuebadin la, deamri: anan aedim samchinan.
Vaafillu lerabbi akiva, deamar: meshiv aveda have – hane mille hecha delekka edim, aval hecha deikka edim – irtote irtat.

Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: adderabba, afillu lerabbi shimon ben elazar deamar: mode miktzat hattaana have – hane mille hecha delekka edim deka mesayyeyi leh, aval hecha deikka edim deka mesayyeyi leh – vadday meshiv aveda have.

Daresh mar zutera mishshemeh derav shimi bar ashe: hilcheta bechol hane shematata, kedishlach leh rabbi abba lerav yosef bar chama. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: derav nachman, may? amar leh: "en govin" matnenan la, vechen amar rav nachman.
Veella hilcheta – leappoke may?

a: I leappoke midderava – mosif hu! i demar bar rav ashe – let hilcheta kemar bar rav ashe! i leappoke middishmuel verav sheshet verav pappa – ha ittotvu!
Ella leappoke midderabbi yochanan, umeatkafta demar bar rav ashe.
Hamechallek nechasav al piv, ribba leechad umiet leechad kulei. hechi dame mattana battechilla, hechi dame baemtza, hechi dame bassof?

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: "tinnaten sade pelonit lifloni, veyirasheha" – zo hi mattana battechilla. "veyirasheha vetinnaten lo" – zo hi mattana bassof. "yirasheha vetinnaten lo veyirasheha" – zo hi mattana baemtza.
Vedavka beadam echad vesade achat; aval beadam echad ushete sadot, sade achat ushene bene adam – lo.
Rabbi elazar omer: afillu adam echad ushete sadot, sade achat ushene bene adam; aval bishte sadot ushene bene adam – lo.
Ki ata ravin, amar: "tinnaten sade pelonit lifloni, veyirash peloni sade pelonit" – rabbi yochanan omer: kana, rabbi elazar omer: lo kana.
Amar leh abbaye leravin: anchett lan chada, veatkeft lan chada! bishlama derabbi elazar adderabbi elazar la kashya – kan beadam echad ushete sadot, kan bishne bene adam ushete sadot;
Ella derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan – kashya!
Amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Veresh lakish amar, lo kana ad sheyyomar: "peloni ufeloni yirshu sade pelonit ufelonit shennetattim lahem bemattana, veyirashum".

Biflugeta – amar rav hamenuna: lo shanu ella adam echad vesade achat; aval adam echad ushete sadot, sade achat ushene bene adam – lo. verav nachman amar: afillu adam echad ushete sadot, sade achat ushene bene adam; aval shete sadot ushene bene adam – lo. verav sheshet amar: afillu shete sadot ushene bene adam.

Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la? detanya, haomer: "tenu shekel levanay beshabbat", ureuyin litten sela – noten lahen sela. veim amar: "al tittenu lahen ella shekel" – en notnin lahen ella shekel. veim amar: "im metu,
b: Yirshu acherim tachtehem" – ben sheamar "tenu" ben sheamar "al tittenu" – en notnin lahen ella shekel.
Veha hacha, dechishte sadot vechishne vene adam dame, vekatane dekane!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la – berauy leyorsho, verabbi yochanan ben beroka hi.

Amar rav ashe, ta shema: "nechasay lecha, veacharecha yirash peloni, veachare acharecha yirash peloni" – met rishon, kana sheni; met sheni, kana shelishi. veim met sheni bechayye rishon – yachzeru nechasim leyorshe rishon.
Veha hacha, dechishte sadot ushene bene adam dame, vekatane dekana!
Vechi tema: hacha name berauy leyorsho, verabbi yochanan ben beroka hi; i hachi, met sheni kana shelishi?!

Ha shelach rav acha bereh derav avya: ledivre rabbi yochanan ben beroka, "nechasay lecha, veacharecha lifloni", verishon rauy leyorsho – en lashsheni bimkom rishon kelum, sheen ze leshon mattana ella leshon yerushsha, virushsha en lah hefsek!
Teyuveta dechullehu! teyuveta.
Lema name tehve teyuveteh deresh lakish? vetisbera?! veha amar rava: hilcheta kevateh deresh lakish behane telat!
La kashya; kan betoch kede dibbur, kan leachar kede dibbur.
Vehilcheta: kol toch kede dibbur kedibbur dame, levar meavoda zara

a: Vekiddushin.

Mishna haomer "ish peloni yirasheni" bimkom sheyyesh bat; "bitti tirasheni" bimkom sheyyesh ben – lo amar kelum, shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: im amar al mi sherauy leyorsho – devarav kayyaymin; veal mi sheen rauy lo leyorsho – en devarav kayyaymin.

Gemara tama deacher bimkom bat, uvat bimkom ben; ha ben ben habbanim, uvat ben habbanot – devarav kayyaymin. ema sefa, rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: im amar al mi sherauy leyorsho – devarav kayyaymin. hayeynu tanna kamma!

Vechi tema rabbi yochanan ben beroka – afillu acher bimkom bat uvat bimkom ben kaamar; vehatanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: lo nechleku abba vachachamim al acher bimkom bat uvat bimkom ben, shello amar kelum;
Al ma nechleku – al ben ben habbanim, uvat ben habbanot; sheabba omer: yirash, vachachamim omrim: lo yirash!
Ibbaet ema: middekaamar "lo nechleku" – mikkelal detanna kamma savar: nechleku.

Ibbaet ema: kulleh derabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, vechassore mechassera vehachi katane: haomer "ish peloni yirasheni" bimkom sheyyesh bat; "bitti tirasheni" bimkom sheyyesh ben – lo amar kelum. ha bat ben habbanot uven ben habbanim – im amar "yirash kol nechasav", devarav kayyaymin; sherabbi yochanan omer: im amar al mi sherauy leyorsho – devarav kayyaymin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka. vechen amar rava: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka.
Amar rava: may tameh derabbi yochanan ben beroka? amar kera: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav" – hattora natna reshut laav lehanechil lechol mi sheyyirtze.
Amar leh abbaye: ha – millo yuchal levakker" nafka!
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya, abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi eliezer:
b: Ma talmud lomar: "lo yuchal levakker"?

Lefi shenneemar: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav". sheyyachol vahalo din hu – uma pashut, sheyyippa kocho, shennotel barauy kivmuchezak – hattora natna reshut laav lehanechil lechol mi sheyyirtze; bechor, shehora kocho, sheeno notel barauy kivmuchezak – lo kol shekken? talmud lomar: "lo yuchal levakker".
Veyomar "lo yuchal levakker"; ma talmud lomar: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav"?
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu – uma bechor, shehora kocho, sheeno notel barauy kivmuchezak – amra tora: "lo yuchal levakker"; pashut, sheyyippa kocho, shennotel barauy kivmuchezak – lo kol shekken?!
Talmud lomar: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav" – hattora natna reshut laav lehanechil lechol mi sheyyirtze.
Amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi amme amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi: halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka. amar leh rabbi abba: "hora" ittemar.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: halacha adifa, umar savar: maase rav.
Tanu rabbanan: en lemedin halacha lo mippi talmud, velo mippi maase, ad sheyyomru lo halacha lemaase. shaal veamru lo halacha lemaase – yelech veyaase maase, uvilvad shello yedamme.
May "uvilvad shello yedamme"? veha kol hattora kullah dammoye medammenan la!
Amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: uvilvad shello yedamme bitrefot.
Detanya: en omrim bitrefot zo doma lazo. veal titma, shehare chotchah mikkan umeta, chotchah mikkan vechayta.
Amar leh rabbi assi lerabbi yochanan: ki amar lan mar "halacha hachi", naaved maase? amar: la tabeydu ad deamena halacha lemaase.

Amar lehu rava lerav pappa ulerav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ki ate piska dedina didi lekammayychu, vechazetu beh pircha – la tikreuhu ad deatetu lekammay; i it li tama – amena lechu, vei la – hadarna bi. leachar mita, la mikra tikreuhu, umigmar name la tigmeru minneh. la mikra tikreuneh – dei havay hatam dilma hava amena lechu tama;

a: Migmar name la tigmeru minneh – deen laddayyayn ella ma sheenav root.
Bae rava: bevari heach? ki kaamar rabbi yochanan ben beroka – bishchiv mera, devar orote hu; aval bevari – la; o dilma afillu bevari name?

Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava: ta shema, deamar lo rabbi natan lerabbi: shenitem mishnatchem kerabbi yochanan ben beroka! ditnan: lo katav lah "benin dichrin deyihvoyn lich minnay, innun yirtun kesef ketubbetich yoter al chulakyhon deim achuhon" – chayyayv, shettenay bet din hu.
Veamar lo rabbi: "yissevun" tenan.

Veamar rabbi: yaldut hayta bi veheazti panay benatan habbavli – ella dekayyma lan: benin dichrin la tarfa mimmeshabedi; i salka datach "yissevun" tenan, ammay la tarfa mimmeshabedi? ella shema minna: "yirtun" tenan.
Man shamat leh deit leh hay sevara – rabbi yochanan ben beroka, ushema minna afillu bevari.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ben leman deamar "yissevun", uven leman deamar "yirtun", ha en adam makne davar shello ba laolam!
Vaafillu lerabbi meir deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam, hane mille ledavar sheyyeshno baolam, aval ledavar sheeno baolam – lo!
Ella tenay bet din shane; hacha name – tenay bet din shane!
Amar leh: mishshum deka mappek la bilshon "yirtun".

Hadar amar abbaye: lav milleta hi daamari, ditnan: lo katav lah "benan nukevan deyihveyayn lichi minnay, yihveyayn yatvan beveti veyittaznan minnichsay ad detillakchan leguverin" – chayyayv, shehu tenay bet din.
Vehave laze bemattana velaze birusha, vechol laze birushsha velaze bemattana – afillu rabbanan modu.
Amar leh rav nechumi veit deamar rav chananya bar minyome, leabbaye:
b: Mimmay divchad be dina ittekun? dilma bitre be dina ittekun!

La salka datach, dekatane resha: ze midrash darash rabbi elazar ben azarya lifne chachamim bakkerem beyavne: habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu; ma habbanim enan yorshin ella leachar mitat avihem, af banot lo yizzonu ella leachar mitat avihen.
I amrat bishlama bechad be dina ittekun, hayeynu deyalfinan takkana mittakkana. ella i amrat bitre be dina ittekun, hechi yalfinan takkana mittakkana?
Mimmay? dilma leolam ema lach bitre be dina ittekun; uve dina batra takkun keve dina kamma, ki hechi dela tikshe takkanta attakkanta.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkotev kol nechasav leishto – lo asaah ella appotroppa.
Peshita, beno haggadol – lo asao ella appotroppos. beno hakkatan may?
Ittemar, rav chanilay bar idde amar shemuel: afillu beno katan hammuttal baarisa.
Peshita, beno veacher – acher bemattana, uveno appotroppos. ishto veacher – leacher bemattana, veishto appotroppos.
Ishto arusa veishto gerusha – bemattana.
Ibbaya lehu: bat etzel habbanim, veishsha etzel haachim, veishsha etzel bene habbaal, mahu?
Amar ravina mishshemeh derava: bechullehu lo kana, levar meishto arusa veishto gerusha. rav avvira mishshemeh derava amar: bechullehu kane, levar mehaishsha etzel haachin veishsha etzel bene habbaal.

a: Bae rava: bevari heach? bishchiv mera hu denicha leh – delishtamun mille, aval bevari – ha kae ihu; o dilma bari name nicha leh, delishtamun mille mehasheta?
Ta shema: hakkotev perot nechasav leishto – gova ketubbatah min hakkarka. lemechetza, lishlish velirvia – gova ketubbatah min hashshear.

Katav kol nechasav leishto, veyatza alav shetar chov – rabbi eliezer omer: tikkara mattenatah vetaamod al ketubbatah. vachachamim omrim: tikkara ketubbatah vetaamod al mattenatah; venimtzet kerachat mikkan umikkan.
Veamar rabbi yehuda hannachtom: maase veera haddavar bevat achoti kalla, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: tikkara ketubbatah vetaamod al mattenatah, venimtzet kerachat mikkan umikkan.
Tama deyatza alav shetar chov, ha lo yatza alav shetar chov – kanya. uvemay? illema bishchiv mera – veha amrat lo asaah ella appotroppos! ella lav bevari?
Leolam bishchiv mera; verav avvira moke la bechullehu, ravina moke la beishto arusa veishto gerusha.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman, halacha: tikkara ketubbatah vetaamod al mattenatah, venimtzet kerachat mikkan umikkan.
Lememra dela azel rav nachman batar umedana?!

Vehatanya: hare shehalach beno limdinat hayyam, veshama shemmet beno, veamad vechatav kol nechasav laacherim, veachar kach ba beno – mattenato mattana. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: en mattenato mattana – sheillu haya yodea shebbeno kayyaym, lo ketavan. veamar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi shimon ben menasya.
Shane hatam, denicha la detippok ala kala dechatvinhu nihala lehanhu nechasim.
Tenan hatam: hakkotev nechasav levanav, vechatav leishto karka kol shehu – ibbeda ketubbatah. mishshum dechatav lah karka kol shehu – ibbeda ketubbatah?!
Amar rav: bimzakke lahen al yadah. ushemuel amar: bimchallek lefaneha vehi shoteket. rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: beomer lah: "teli karka zo bichtubbatich".
b: Umikkulle chetubba shanu kan.
Tenan, rabbi yose omer: im kibbela aleha, af al pi shello katav lah – ibbeda ketubbatah. mikkelal detanna kamma savar: ketiva vekabbala bae!

Vechi tema: kulla rabbi yose hi; veha tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay – shehayta sham vekibbela aleha; aval hayta sham velo kibbela aleha, kibbela aleha velo hayta sham – lo ibbeda ketubbatah! teyuveta dechullehu! teyuveta.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: ha rav, ha shemuel, ha rabbi yose berabbi chanina. mar – may sevira leh? amar leh, sheani omer: kevan sheasaah shuttaf ben habbanim – ibbeda ketubbatah.
Ittemar name, amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: kevan sheasaah shuttaf ben habbanim – ibbeda ketubbatah.
Bae rava: bevari heach? mi amrinan: bishchiv mera hu deyada delet leh – vekamachala, aval bevari – savra hadar kane; o dilma, hasheta mihat let leh? teku.

Hahu daamar lehu: "palga livrat, ufalga livrat, vetilta leittat befere". ikkela rav nachman lesura, ul legabbe rav chisda, amar leh: ki hay gavvna may? amar leh, hachi amar shemuel: afillu lo hikna lah ella dekel echad leferotav – ibbeda ketubbatah.
Amar leh: emor deamar shemuel hatam – deakni la begufa deara; hacha – pera hu! amar leh: mittalteli ka amrat? mittalteli vadday la ka amena.
Hahu daamar lehu: "tilta livrat, vetilta livrat, vetilta leittat". shechiva chada mibbenateh. sevar rav pappe lememar: la shakla ella telata.

a: Amar leh rav kahana: illu hadar kane, mi la shakla? vechevan deillu hadar kane – shakla, hasheta name shakla.

Hahu defalginhu lenichseh leitteteh velivneh, shayyayr chad dikla. sevar ravina lememar: let la ella chad dikla. amar leh rav yemar leravina: i let la, chad dikla name let la! ella miggo denachata ledikla, nachata name lechullehu nichse.
Amar rav huna: shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leacher – roin; im rauy leyorsho – notlan mishshum yerushsha, veim lav – notlan mishshum mattana.
Amar leh rav nachman: gannava gannove lema lach? i sevira lach kerabbi yochanan ben beroka, ema: "halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka" – deha shematetaych kerabbi yochanan ben beroka hu deazla!

Dilma ki ha kaamrat – dehahu dahava ka shachev, vaamaru leh: nichseh leman, dilma liflanya? vaamar lehu: ella leman? vaamart lan ala: im rauy leyorsho – notlan mishshum yerushsha, veim lav – notlan mishshum mattana. amar leh: in, hachi kaamena.
Lemay hilcheta? savar rav adda bar ahava kammeh derava lememar: im rauy leyorsho – almenato nizzonet minnechasav, veim lav – en almenato nizzonet minnechasav.
Amar leh rava: migra gara?! hasheta birusha – deorayyta, amrat almenato nizzonet minnechasav; bemattana – derabbanan, lo kol shekken?!

Ella amar rava, kedishlach rav acha bar rav avya: ledivre rabbi yochanan ben beroka, "nechasay lecha, veacharecha lifloni", im haya rishon rauy leyorsho – en lashsheni bimkom rishon kelum; sheen leshon mattana ella leshon yerushsha, virushsha en lah hefsek.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: veha afseka! hu savar – yesh lah hefsek, verachamana amar: en lah hefsek.
b: Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "nechasay lecha, veacharecha lifloni", verishon rauy leyorsho hava. shachev rishon, ata sheni ka tava.
Sevar rav ilish kammeh derava lememar: sheni name shakel. amar leh: dayyayne dachatzatzta hachi dayyni! lav hayeynu dishlach rav acha bar rav avya?
Ikkesif. kare aleh "ani Adonai beittah achishenna".
Mishna hakkotev et nechasav laacherim vehinniach et banav – ma sheasa asuy, ella en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im lo hayu banav nohagim kashshura – zachur lattov.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: mi peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel, o la?

Ta shema: deyosef ben yoezer haya lo ben shello haya noheg kashshura. hava leh illita dedinare, kam akdesha. azal nesev bat gadel kelile deyannay malka. olida devethu, zabben la binita. kara, ashkach bah margalita.
Amara leh: la tamteyay lemalka, deshakli la minnach bidme kallile; zil amteyay legabbe gizbare. vela teshayyeyma at, daamirato legavoah kimsirato lehedyot, ella leshayyeymuha inhu.
Amteyay, shamuha bitlesre illiyyata dedinare. amri leh: sheva ikka, shet lekka. amar lehu: sheva havu li, shet hare hen mukedashot lashshamayim.
Amdu vechatvu: yosef ben yoezer hichnis achat, uveno hichnis shesh. veikka deamri: yosef ben yoezer hichnis achat, uveno hotzi sheva.
Middeka amri "hichnis", mikkelal deshappir avad! adderabba, middeka amri "hotzi", mikkelal delav shappir avad! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
May have ala? ta shema, daamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, la teyhavve be abbore achsanta; vaafillu mibbera bisha livra tava, vechol shekken mibbera levarta.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beadam echad shello hayu banav nohagin kashshura, amad vechatav nechasav leyonatan ben uzziel. ma asa yonatan ben uzziel? machar shelish, vehikdish shelish, vehechezir levanav shelish.
Ba alav shammay bemaklo vetarmilo. amar lo: shammay, im atta yachol lehotzi et ma shemmacharti uma shehikdashti – atta yachol lehotzi ma shehechzarti,

a: Im lav – i atta yachol lehotzi ma shehechzarti. amar: hetiach alay ben uzziel! hetiach alay ben uzziel!
Meikkara may savar? mishshum maase devet choron.

Ditnan: maase bevet choron, beechad shehaya aviv muddar hemennu hanaa, vehaya massi beno; veamar lachavero: hare chatzer useuda netunin lecha bemattana, veenan lefanecha ella kede sheyyavo abba veyochal immanu basseuda.

Amar lo: im shelli hen – hare hen mukedashin lashshamayim! amar lo: lo natatti lecha et shelli shettakdishem lashshamayim! amar lo: lo natatta li et shellecha ella shettehe atta veavich ochlin veshotin umeratztzin ze laze, vihe avon taluy berosho!
Amru chachamim: kol mattana sheenah sheim hikdishah mukedeshet – enah mattana.

Tanu rabbanan: shemonim talmidim hayu lo lehillel hazzaken; sheloshim mehen reuyim shettishre alehen shechina kemoshe rabbenu, sheloshim mehen reuyim shettaamod lahen chamma kihoshua bin nun, esrim benoniyyim. gadol shebbechullan – yonatan ben uzziel, katan shebbechullan – rabban yochanan ben zakkay.

Amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shello hinniach mikra, umishna, talmud, halachot, veaggadot, dikduke tora, vedikidduke sofrim, vekallin vachamurin, ugezerot shavot, utekufot, vegimatriyyaot, umishlot kovsim, umishlot shualim, sichat shedim, vesichat dekalim, vesichat malache hashsharet, vedavar gadol, vedavar katan.
"Davar gadol" – maase merkava, "vedavar katan" – havayot deabbaye verava. lekayyem ma shenneemar: "lehanechil ohavay yesh, veotzrotehem amalle".
Vechi meachar dekatan shebbechullam ken, gadol shebbechullam – al achat kamma vechamma. amru alav al yonatan ben uzziel, beshaa sheyyoshev veosek battora – kol of shepporeach alav nisraf.
Mishna haomer "ze beni" – neeman, "ze achi" – eno neeman, veyittol immo bechelko.
Met – yachzeru nechasim limkoman.
Naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher, yirshu echav immo.
Gemara "ze beni" – neeman. lemay hilcheta? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: leyorsho, veliftor et ishto min hayyibbum.
b: Leyorsho – peshita! liftor et ishto min hayyibbum itztericha leh.
Ha name tenena – mi sheamar bishat mitato: "yesh li banim" – neeman. "yesh li achim" – eno neeman!
Hatam – dela muchezak lan beach, hacha – af al gav demuchezak leh beach.
Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, mippene ma amru: "ze beni" – neeman? hoil uvaal sheamar: "gerashti et ishti" – neeman.
Amar rav yosef: mareh deavraham! tale tanya bidla tanya?!
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, mippene ma amru: "ze beni" neeman? hoil uveyado legarshah.
Amar rav yosef: hasheta deamrat amrinan "hoil", baal sheamar "gerashti et ishti" – neeman, hoil uveyado legarshah.
Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar rabbi yochanan: baal sheamar "gerashti et ishti" – eno neeman. menappach rav sheshet bideh: azal leh "hoil" derav yosef.
Ini?! veha amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: baal sheamar "gerashti et ishti" – neeman!
La kashya; kan lemafrea,
Kan lehabba.
Ibbaya lehu: amar lemafrea, mahu lehemoneh lehabba?
Mi palginan dibbura, o la palginan dibbura? rav mari verav zevid; chad amar: palginan, vechad amar: la palginan.
May shena midderava? deamar rava: "ish peloni ba al ishti" – hu veacher mitztarfin lehorgo. lehorgo, velo lehorgah!
Bitre gufe palginan, bechad gufa la palginan.

a: Hahu dahava ka shachev, amaru leh: itteteh leman? amar lehu: chazya lechahana rabba.

Amar rava: may nechush la? ha amar rav chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: baal sheamar "gerashti et ishti" – neeman! amar leh abbaye, veha ki ata rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: baal sheamar "gerashti et ishti" – eno neeman! amar leh: (velav) mi la shanninhu – kan lemafrea, vechan lehabba?
Veashshinnuye nekum velismoch?! amar leh rava lerav natan bar amme: chush la.

Hahu dahava muchezak lan delet leh ache, vaamar bishat mita delet leh ache. amar rav yosef: may lechush la? chada, demuchezak lan delet leh achin. veod, ha amar bishat mita delet leh. amar leh abbaye: ha amri deikka edim bimdinat hayyam deyadi deit leh ache!
Hasheta mihat ha letanhu kamman; lav hayeynu derabbi chanina – deamar rabbi chanina: edim betzad astan, veteaser?!
Amar leh abbaye: im hekalnu bishvuya – mishshum dimnavvevla nafshah legabbe shabbay; nakel beeshet ish?! amar leh rava lerav natan bar amme: chush la.
"Ze achi" – eno neeman. veiddach may kaamri? i kaamri "achuna hu", ammay yittol immo bechelko vetu la? ella deka amri "lav achinu hu"?
Ema sefa: naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher – yirshu echav immo. ha amri leh: "lav achuna hu"!
La tzericha, deka amri: "en anu yodin".
Amar rava, zot omeret: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer "eni yodea" – patur.
Abbaye amar:
b: Leolam ema lach chayyayv; veshane hacha, dichmane leacher beyadcha" dame.
Met – yachzeru nechasim limkoman. bae rava: shevach sheshshavchu nechasim mealehem, mahu?

Beshevach hammaggia lakketefayim – la tibbee lach, dechi naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher dame. ki tibbee lach – beshevach sheeno maggia lakketefayim; kegon dikla vaalem, ara veasseka sirton; may? teku.
Mishna mi shemmet venimtzet deyayteke keshura al yerecho – hare zo enah kelum. zikka bah leacher – ben min hayyorshin, ben sheenan min hayyorshin – devarav kayyaymin.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: eze hi deyayteke? kol shekkatuv bah: "da tehe lemekam velihyot". veeze hi mattana? kol shekkatuv bah: "mehayyom uleachar mita".

Ella "mehayyom uleachar mita" – hu dehavya mattana, "meachshav" – la havya mattana?! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: ezo hi mattenat bari shehi kemattenat shechiv mera – dela kane ella leachar mita? kol shekkatuv bah: "mehayyom uleachar mita".

Yatev rabba bar rav huna beachsadra deve rav, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: shechiv mera sheamar "kitvu utenu mane lifloni", umet – en kotvin venotnin; shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita.
Amar lehu rabbi elazar: izdeharu ba. rav shezvi amar: rabbi elazar amra, vaamar lehu rabbi yochanan: izdeharu ba.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kevateh derav shezvi mistabbera. i amrat bishlama rabbi elazar amra, itzterich rabbi yochanan leashode aleh derabbi elazar. ella i amrat rabbi yochanan amra, itzterich rabbi elazar leashode aleh derabbi yochanan rabbeh?!

Veod, ta shema derabbi elazar amra, dishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi avahu: hevu yodim sheshshalach rabbi elazar laggola mishshum rabbenu: shechiv mera sheamar "kitvu utenu mane lifloni", umet – en kotvin venotnin; shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar, veen shetar leachar mita. verabbi yochanan amar: tibbadek.
May "tibbadek"? ki ata rav dimi amar: deyayteke mevattelet deyayteke. shechiv mera sheamar: "kitvu utenu mane lifloni", umet – roin; im kimyappe et kocho – kotvin, veim lav – en kotvin.
Metiv rabbi abba bar memel: bari sheamar "kitvu utenu mane lifloni", umet – en kotvin venotnin. ha shechiv mera – kotvin venotnin! hu motev la vehu mefarek la – bimyappe et kocho.
Hechi dame meyappe et kocho?

a: Kidamar rav chisda: "ukenena minneh mosif al mattanta da"; hacha name – deamar: "af ketovu vachatomu vehavu leh".
Ittemar rav yehuda amar shemuel, halacha: kotvin venotnin. vechen amar rava amar rav nachman, halacha: kotvin venotnin.
Mishna hakkotev nechasav levanav, tzarich sheyyichtov "mehayyom uleachar mita", divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: eno tzarich.
Hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto – haav eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen ketuvin labben; vehabben eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen birshut haav.
Machar haav – mechurim ad sheyyamut. machar habben – en lallokeach bahen kelum ad sheyyamut haav.
Gemara vechi katav "mehayyom uleachar mita", may have? ha tenan: "mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get; veim met, choletzet velo mityaybemet!
Hatam – mesappeka lan i tenaa have, i chazara have; aval hacha – hachi kaamar leh: gufa keni mehayyom, pera leachar mita.

Rabbi yose omer: eno tzarich. rabba bar avu chalash, al legabbeh rav huna verav nachman. amar leh rav huna lerav nachman, bei minneh: halacha kerabbi yose, o en halacha kerabbi yose? amar leh: tameh derabbi yose la yadana, halacha eve minneh? amar leh: at bei minneh i halacha i la, vetameh ana amena lach.

Bea minneh. amar leh, hachi amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose. batar dinfaku, amar leh: hayeynu tameh derabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav. tanya name hachi, rabbi yose omer: eno tzarich, mippene shezzemanno shel shetar mochiach alav.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: behakenaa, mahu? amar leh: behakenaa – eno tzarich.
Rav pappe amar: ikka akneyata ditzrich, veikka akneyata dela tzerich. "akneyeh ukenena minneh" – la tzarich. "kenena minneh veakneyeh" – tzerich.
Matkef la rav chanina missura: mi ikka midde daanan la yadinan, vesafre yadi? sheelunehu lesafre deabbaye – veyadi, ulesafre derava – veyadi.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: ben "akneyeh ukenena minneh", ben "kenena minneh veakneyeh" – la tzerich; uveducheran pitgame dahave beanpana" peligi.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, vaamar li: attun – hachi matnitu la; anan – hachi matnenan lah: amar rava amar rav nachman, behakenaa, eno tzarich – ben "akneyeh ukenena minneh", ben "kenena minneh veakneyeh" – la tzerich. beducheran pitgame dahavo beanpana" – peligi.
Hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto. ittemar: machar habben bechayye haav, umet habben bechayye haav –
b: Amar rabbi yochanan: lo kana lokeach. veresh lakish amar: kana lokeach.
Rabbi yochanan amar: lo kana lokeach – kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame.
Veresh lakish amar: kana lokeach – kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
Veha ippeligu ba chada zimna! deittemar: hammocher sadehu leferot – rabbi yochanan amar: mevi vekore. veresh lakish amar: mevi, veeno kore.
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore – kasavar: kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame. veresh lakish amar: mevi veeno kore – kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: af al gav divalma kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame, hacha itzterich; salka datach amena: abba legabbe bereh achole achel, ka mashma lan.

Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: af al gav divalma kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame, hacha itzterich; salka datach amena: kol legabbe nafsheh, afillu bimkom bereh, nafsheh adifa leh; ka mashma lan.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "nechasay lecha, veacharecha yirash peloni, veacharav yirash peloni" – met rishon, kana sheni. met sheni, kana shelishi.
Met sheni bechayye rishon – yachzeru nechasim leyorshe rishon.
Veim ita, leyorshe noten mibbee leh!
Amar leh: kevar targema rav hoshaya bevavel: "acharecha" shane. vechen rame rabba bar rav huna kammeh derav, veamar: "acharecha" shane.
Vehatanya: yachzeru leyorshe noten!

a: Tannae hi. detanya: "nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni", veyarad rishon umachar veachal – hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon.
Ureminhi: "nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni" – yored rishon umocher veochel, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en larishon ella achilat perot bilvad.
Kashya derabbi adderabbi, uderabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel!
Derabbi adderabbi la kashya – ha legufa, ha lefera. derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel la kashya – ha lechattechilla, ha diavad.
Amar abbaye: ezehu rasha arum? ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. umode, sheim netanan bemattenat shechiv mera – lo asa kelum.
May tama? amar abbaye: mattenat shechiv mera lo kana ella leachar mita, uchevar kedamo "acharecha".
Umi amar abbaye hachi? veha ittemar: mattenat shechiv mera, meematay kana? abbaye amar: im gemar mita, verava amar: leachar gemar mita!
Hadar beh abbaye mehahi. mimmay demehahi hadar beh? dilma meha hadar beh!
La salka datach, ditnan: "ze gittech im matti"; "ze gittech mecholi ze"; "ze gittech leachar mita" – lo amar kelum.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, vaafillu hayu bahen avadim vehotzian lecherut.
Peshita! mahu detema, amar leh: lemebad issura la yahavinan lach; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav yosef amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, vaafillu asaan tachrichin lemet. peshita! mahu detema: leshauoyinhu issure hanaa la yehavi lach; ka mashma lan.
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: "etrog ze natun lecha bemattana, veacharecha lifloni", netalo rishon veyatza bo – banu lemachloket rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel.

Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ad kan la peligi rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel hatam, ella demar savar: kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame, umar savar: kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame. ella hacha,
b: I mippak la nafek beh, lemay yahaveh nihaleh?
Ella mippak – dechulle alma la peligi, denafek beh; mecharah o achalah – banu lemachloket rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: haachin shekkanu etrog bitfusat habbayit; netalo echad mehen veyatza bo – im yachol leochlo, yatza; veim lav, lo yatza.
Vedavka deikka etrog lechol chad vechad, aval parish o rimmon – lo.
Amar rava: "etrog ze natun lecha bemattana, al menat shettachzirehu li", netalo veyatza bo; hechziro – yatza, lo hechziro – lo yatza. ka mashma lan demattana al menat lehachazir – shemah mattana.
Hahi itteta dahava la dikla beara derav bivi bar abbaye. kol emat dahavat azla lemigzereh, hava kafed illava. akniteh nihaleh kol shene chayyav. azal ihu akneyeh nihaleh livno katan.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mishshum deatu mimmulae, amritu mille muleyata? afillu rabban shimon ben gamliel la kaamar ella leacher, aval leatzmo – lo.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: "shor ze natun lecha bemattana, al menat shettachzirehu li"; hikdisho vehechziro – hare ze mukedash umuchezar.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: may ahdereh? amar leh: umay chassereh? ella amar rav ashe: chazenan; i amar leh: "al menat shettachzirehu" – ha ahdereh. i amar leh: "al menat shettachzirehu li" – midde dachaze leh kaamar leh.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkotev nechasav leacher, veamar halla "i efshi bahen" – kana, vaafillu omed vetzoveach. verabbi yochanan amar: lo kana.
Amar rabbi abba bar memel: vela peligi;

a: Kan betzoveach meikkara, kan beshotek meikkara ulevassof tzoveach.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: zikka lo al yede acher, veshatak ulevassof tzavavch – banu lemachloket rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan,

Detanya: hakkotev nechasav leacher, vehayu bahen avadim, veamar halla: "i efshi bahen"; im haya rabban sheni kohen – hare ellu ochlin bitruma. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kevan sheamar halla: "i efshi bahen" – kevar zachu bahen yorshin.
Vehavenan ba: vetanna kamma – afillu omed vetzoveach?!
Amar rava, veittema rabbi yochanan: betzoveach meikkaro – dechulle alma la peligi dela kane. shatak ulevassof tzavavch – dechulle alma la peligi dekane.
Ki peligi – shezzikka lo al yede acher veshatak, ulevassof tzavavch; detanna kamma savar: middishtek – keninhu; vehay deka tzavavch – mihdar hu deka hadar beh.
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: hochiach sofo al techillato; vehay dela tzavavch ad hasheta – desavar: ki la matu lidi, may etzvavch.

Tanu rabbanan, shechiv mera sheamar: "tenu matayim zuz lifloni, ushelosh meot lifloni, vearba meot lifloni" – en omrin: kol hakkodem bishtar, zoche. lefichach, yatza alav shetar chov – gove mikkullam.

Aval amar: "tenu matayim zuz lifloni, veacharav lifloni, veacharav lifloni" – omrin: kol hakkodem bashshetar, zoche. lefichach, yatza alav shetar chov – gove min haacharon. en lo – gove mishshellefanav. en lo – gove mishshellifne fanav.

Tanu rabbanan, shechiv mera sheamar: "tenu matayim zuz lifloni beni bechor, karauy lo" – notlan, venotel et bechorato. im amar: "bivchorato" – yado al haelyona; ratza – notlan, ratza – notel bechorato.
Ushechiv mera sheamar: "tenu matayim zuz liflonit ishti, karauy lah" – notaltan, venotelet et ketubbatah. im amar "bichtubbatah" –
b: Yadah al haelyona; ratza – notaltan, ratza – notelet ketubbatah.
Ushechiv mera sheamar: "tenu matayim zuz lifloni baal chovi, karauy lo" – notlan, venotel et chovo. veim amar: "bechovo" – notlan bechovo.
Mishshum deamar "karauy lo" – notlan venotel et chovo?! vedilma "karauy lo bechovo" kaamar!
Amar rav nachman, amar li huna: ha manni – rabbi akiva hi, dedayek lishshana yattira;
Ditnan: velo et habbor velo et haddut, af al pi shekkatav lo umeka veruma. vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva.
Vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich likkach lo derech. umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo "chutz meellu" – sheeno tzarich likkach lo derech.
Alma, kevan dela tzerich, vekaamar – letappoye milleta kaate; hacha name, kevan dela tzerich, vekaamar – letappoye milleta ka ate.

Tanu rabbanan, shechiv mera sheamar: "mane yesh li etzel peloni" – haedim kotvin, af al pi sheen makkirin. lefichach, keshehu gove – tzarich lehavi reaya, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en kotvin ella im ken makkirin, lefichach keshehu gove – en tzarich lehavi reaya.

Amar rav nachman, amar li huna: tana, rabbi meir omer: en kotvin, vachachamim omrim: kotvin. veaf rabbi meir la amar ella mishshum bet din toin. amar rav dimi minnehardea, hilcheta: en choshshin levet din toin.
Umay shena midderava? deamar rava: en choltzin ella im ken makkirin, veen memaanin ella im ken makkirin. lefichach kotvin get chalitza veget meun, veaf al pi sheen makkirin.
May tama? lav mishshum dechoshshin levet din toin?
La; bet dina batar bet dina – la dayyki, bet dina batar edim – dayyki.
Mishna haav tolesh umaachil lechol mi sheyyirtze, uma shehinniach talush – hare hu shel yorshin.
Gemara talush in, mechubbar lo.

a: Veha tanya: shamin et hamechubbarin lallokeach!
Amar ulla: la kashya; kan bivno, kan beacher; hoil vedato shel adam kerova etzel beno.
Mishna hinniach banim gedolim uketannim – en haggedolim mitparnesin al yede hakketannim, velo hakketannim nizzonin al haggedolim, ella cholkin beshave.
Nasu haggedolim – yisou hakketannim. veim amru ketannim: hare anu nosin kederech shennesatem attem – en shomin lahem; ella ma shennatan lahem avihem, natan.
Hinniach banot gedolot uketannot – en haggedolot mitparnesot al yede hakketannot, velo hakketannot nizzonot al haggedolot, ella cholkot beshave.
Nasu gedolot – yisseu ketannot. veim amru ketannot: hare anu nosot kederech shennesatem attem – en shomin lahen.
Ze chomer babbanot mibbabbanim – shehabbanot nizzonot al habbanim, veen nizzonot al habbanot.
Gemara amar rava: hay gedol ache dilvash veikkassi mibbeta – may daavad avad.
Veha anan tenan: en haggedolim mitparnesin al hakketannim! matnitin – bishracha.
Sheracha – peshita! mahu detema: nicha lehu dela ninnavvavl; ka mashma lan.
Nasu gedolim yisseu ketannim. may kaamar?

Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: nasu gedolim leachar mitat avihen – yisseu ketannim leachar mitat avihen. aval nasu gedolim bechayye avihen, veamru ketannim leachar mitat avihen: "hare anu nosin kederech shennesatem attem" – en shomin lahen, ella ma shennatan lahen avihen – natan.
Hinniach banot gedolot uketannot. shelach leh avu bar geniva lerava, yelammedenu rabbenu: lavvta veachla, veamda venisset – baal lokeach have, o yoresh have?
Lokeach have – umilve al pe eno gove min hallakochot; o dilma yoresh have – umilve al pe gove min hayyorshin?
Amar leh, tenena: nasu gedolot – yisseu ketannot. may, lav nasu gedolot levaal – yisseu ketannot mibbaal?
Lo; nasu gedolot levaal – yisseu ketannot levaal.
Ini?! veha tane rabbi chiyyay: nasu gedolot levaal – yisseu ketannot mibbaal!
Dilma shane parnasa, deit la kala.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava, lav hayeynu dishlach ravin beiggarteh: mi shemmet, vehinniach almana uvat – almenato nizzonet minnechasav. nisset habbat – almenato nizzonet minnechasav. meta habbat – amar rav yehuda ben achoto shel rabbi yose [ben chanina]: al yadi haya maase, veamru: almenato nizzonet minnechasav.
I amrat bishlama yoresh have, mishshum hachi almenato nizzonet minnechasav; ella i amrat lokeach have, ammay nizzonet minnechasav?
Amar abbaye: i lav dishlach ravin, anan la yadinan? veha tenan: ellu hen sheen chozrin bayyovel – habbechora,
b: Vehayyoresh et ishto!
Amar leh rava: vehasheta dishlach, mi yadinan?! haamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: beusha hitkinu, haishsha shemmachra nichse melog bechayye balah, umeta – habbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot.

Ella amar rav ashe: baal – shavveyuhu rabbanan keyoresh, veshavveyuhu rabbanan kelokeach, vehecha detava leh avadu leh; gabbe yovel – shavveyuhu rabbanan keyoresh, mishshum peseda dideh. gabbe derabbi yose berabbi chanina – shavveyuhu rabbanan kelokeach, mishshum peseda dideh. gabbe deravin – mishshum peseda dealmana, shavveyuhu rabbanan keyoresh.
Veha gabbe derabbi yose berabbi chanina, deikka peseda lelakochot, veshavveyuhu rabbanan kelokeach!
Hatam, inhu afsidu annafshayyhu – kevan deikka baal, la ibbei lehu lemizban meitteta deyatva tute gavra.
Hadaran alach yesh nochalin

Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot; bizman shehannechasim merubbin – habbanim yirshu, vehabbanot yizzonu. nechasim muatin – habbanot yizzonu, vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim. admon omer: bishvil sheani zachar, hifsadti?! amar rabban gamliel: roe ani et divre admon.

Gemara vechamma merubbin? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kede sheyyizzonu mehen ellu vaellu shenem asar chodesh. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: zo divre rabban gamliel bar rabbi, aval chachamim omrim: kede sheyyizzonu mehen ellu vaellu ad sheyyivgeru.

Ittemar name: ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol sheyyizzonu mehen ellu vaellu ad sheyyivgeru – hen merubbin; pachot mikkan – hare ellu muatin.
Vei lekka leellu vaellu ad sheyyivgeru,

a: Shakli lehu banot lechullehu?! ella amar rava: motziin lahen mezonot labbanot ad sheyyivgeru, vehashshear labbanim.
Peshita – merubbin venitmaatu, kevar zachu bahen yorshin. muatin venitrabbu, may? birshut yorshin kayymi – hilkach birshut yorshin shevuch; o dilma, salloke mesalleki yorshin mehacha?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: yetomin shekkadmu umachru binchasim muatin – ma shemmachru, machru.

Yatev rabbi yirmeya kammeh derabbi avahu, veka bae minneh: almenato, mahu shettemaet bannechasim? mi amrinan: kevan deit la mezone – memaata; o dilma, kevan deillu minnasva – let la, hasheta name let la?

Im timtza lomar: kevan deillu minnasva let la – hasheta name let la; bat ishto, mahu shettemaet bannechasim? mi amrinan: kevan dechi minnasva name it la – umemaata; o dilma, kevan deillu meta let la – vela memaata?

Veim timtza lomar: kevan deillu meta let la – vela memaata; baal chov – mahu sheyyemaet bannechasim? mi amrinan: kevan dechi mayet name it leh, memaet; o dilma, kevan dimchasseri guveyayna, la memaet?
Veikka devae la leiddach gisa – baal chov, mahu sheyyemaet bannechasim?
b: Bat ishto, mahu shettemaet bannechasim? almenato, mahu shettemaet bannechasim? almenato uvat – e ze mehen kodemet?

Amar leh: zil haiddana veta limchar. ki ata, amar leh: peshot mihat chada, deamar rabbi abba amar rabbi assi: asu almana etzel habbat – kabbat etzel haachin binchasim muatin; ma bat etzel achin – habbat nizzonet, vehaachin yishalu al happetachim; af almana etzel habbat – almana nizzonet, vehabbat tishal al happetachim.

Admon omer: bishvil sheani zachar, hifsadti? vechulei. may kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: bishvil sheani zachar, verauy ani laasok battora, hifsadti? amar leh rava: ella meatta, man deasek battora hu deyaret, dela asek battora la yeret? ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: bishvil sheani zachar, verauy ani lirash binchasim merubbin, hifsadti binchasim muatin?
Mishna hinniach banim uvanot, vetumetum; bizman shehannechasim merubbin – hazzecharim dochin oto etzel nekevot. nechasim muatin – hannekevot dochot oto etzel zecharim.
Haomer "im teled ishti zachar – yittol mane", yalda zachar – yittol mane. "nekeva – matayim", yalda nekeva – notelet matayim.

"Im zachar – mane, im nekeva – matayim", veyalda zachar unekeva – zachar notel mane, nekeva notelet matayim. yalda tumetum – eno notel. im amar: "kol ma shetteled ishti, yittol" – hare ze yittol. veim en sham yoresh ella hu – yoresh et hakkol.
Gemara dochin oto – veshakel kevat? ha katane sefa: yalda tumetum – eno notel! amar abbaye: dochin oto – veen lo.
Verava amar: dochin oto – veyesh lo, vesefa atan lerabban shimon ben gamliel – detanya: yalda tumetum veanderoginos – rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en kedushsha chala alehen.
Metivi: tumetum yoresh keven, venizzon kevat. bishlama lerava, yoresh keven – binchasim muatin, venizzon kevat – binchasim merubbin.

a: Ella leabbaye, may "nizzon kevat"? uletamaych – lerava may "yoresh keven"? ella rauy lirash – veen lo; hacha name, rauy lizzon – veen lo.

Haomer: im yalda ishti zachar vechulei. lememra devat adifa leh mibben? veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol sheeno manniach ben leyorsho – hakkadosh baruch hu male alav evra, shenneemar: "vehaavartem et nachalato levitto" – veen "haavara" ella evra, shenneemar: "yom evra hayyom hahu"!
Leinyan yerushsha – ben adif leh. leinyan harevavcha – bitto adifa leh.

Ushemuel amar: hacha bimvakkeret askinan, vechidrav chisda – deamar rav chisda: bat techilla – siman yafe levanim. ikka deamri: dimrabbeya laachaha, veikka deamri: dela shalta beh ena bisha. amar rav chisda: uledidi – benatan adifan li mibbene.
Veibbaet ema: ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi.

He rabbi yehuda? ilema rabbi yehuda devakkol" – detanya: "vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol" – rabbi meir omer: shello haya lo bat. rabbi yehuda omer: shehayta lo bat, uvakkol" shemah. emor deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda – beratta name la chassereh rachamana leavraham; daadifa mibben mi shamat leh?!

Ella ha rabbi yehuda – detanya: mitzva lazun et habbanot, vekal vachomer labbanim – deaski battora, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: mitzva lazun et habbanim, vekal vachomer libbanot – dela littazlan.
Ella ha detanya: yalda zachar unekeva – hazzachar notel shishsha dinarin, vehannekeva notelet shene dinarin; bemay?

Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana: bimsares, deamar: "zachar techilla – matayim, nekeva acharav – vela kelum. nekeva techilla – mane, zachar achareha – mane". veyalda zachar unekeva, vela yadinan he minnayyhu nefak beresha. zachar shakel mane mimma nafshach, iddach mane – have mamon hammuttal besafek, vecholkin.
Veha detanya: yalda zachar unekeva – en lo ella mane, hechi mashkachat la? amar ravina: bimvassereni" –
b: Detanya: "hamevassereni bamme niftar rachmah shel ishti; im zachar – yittol mane", yalda zachar – notel mane. "im nekeva – mane"; yalda nekeva – notel mane, yalda zachar unekeva – en lo ella mane.
Veha "zachar unekeva" la amar! deamar name "im zachar unekeva name – yittol mane". ella lemaote may? lemaote nefel.
Hahu daamar la lidvethu: nichsay lehay dimabberat. amar rav huna: have mezakke leubbar, vehamezakke leubbar lo kana.
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: haomer "im yalda ishti zachar – yittol mane", yalda zachar – notel mane! amar leh: mishnatenu – eni yodea mi shenaah.
Velema leh: rabbi meir hi, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam!
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi meir – ledavar sheyyeshno baolam; ledavar sheeno baolam mi shamat leh?!
Velema leh: rabbi yose hi, deamar: ubbar kane! ditnan: ubbar posel veeno maachil, divre rabbi yose.
Shane yerushsha, habbaa meeleha.
Velema leh: rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, daamar: la shena yerushsha vela shena mattana! ditnan, rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: im amar al mi sherauy leyorsho – devarav kayyaymin!
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi yochanan ben beroka – ledavar sheyyeshno baolam; ledavar sheeno baolam mi amar?!
Velema leh: rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, vesavar la kerabbi yose! mi yemar desavar la?
Velema leh: bimvassereni"! i hachi, dekatane sefa: veim en sham yoresh ella hu – yoresh hakkol; i bimvassereni", yoresh may avidteh?
Velema leh besheyyalda! i hachi, dekatane sefa: veim amar "kol ma shetteled ishti – yittol", hare ze yittol; "kol shetteled"?! "kol sheyyalda" mibbee leh!

a: Velema leh deamar lichshetteled! rav huna letameh, deamar rav huna: af lichshetteled – lo kana.
Deamar rav nachman: hamezakke leubbar – lo kana. lichshetteled – kana. verav huna amar: af lichshetteled – lo kana. verav sheshet amar: echad ze veechad ze kana.

Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la? detanya: ger shemmet, uvizbezu yisrael nechasav, veshamu sheyyesh lo ben o shehayta ishto meubberet – chayyayvin lehachazir. hechziru hakkol, veachar kach shamu shemmet beno o shehippila ishto – hechzik bashsheniyya, kana; uvarishona, lo kana.
Vei salka datach: ubbar la kane, lema lehu achzoke bashsheniyya? ha achziku lehu chada zimna!
Amar abbaye: yerushsha habbaa meeleha shane. rava amar: shane hatam, derappoye merappeyan bidayyhu meikkara.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu sheshshamu bo shemmet – velo met; veachar kach met.
Ta shema: tinok ben yom echad – nochel umanchil. ben yom echad in, ubbar la! ha amar rav sheshet: nochel benichse haem, lehanechil laachin min haav. vedavka ben yom echad, aval ubbar – la. may tama?
b: Dehu mayet beresha, veen habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanechil laachin min haav.
Lememra dehu mayet beresha?! veha hava ovada, ufarkes telata pirkuse! amar mar bar rav ashe: midde dehave azzenav halletaa, shemmefarkeset.
Mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava amar: lomar shemmemaet bechelek bechora. vedavka ben yom echad, aval ubbar – la. may tama? "veyaldu lo" amar rachamana.
Deamar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava: ben shennolad leachar mitat aviv – eno memaet bechelek bechora. may tama? "veyaldu lo" amar rachamana, veha lekka.

Besura – matnu hachi. befumebdita – matnu hachi: amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava: bechor shennolad leachar mitat aviv – eno notel pi shenayim. may tama? "yakkir" amar rachamana, veha leta deyakkir. vehilcheta kechol hane lishshane deamar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava.
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: hamezakke leubbar – lo kana. veim tomar: mishnatenu! hoil vedato shel adam kerova etzel beno.
Amar leh shemuel lerav chana bagdataa: pok ayyti li be asra, veemar lach beappayyhu: hamezakke leubbar kana. vehilcheta: hamezakke leubbar lo kana.
Hahu daamar lidvethu: "nichsay livne deyihvu li minnich". ata bereh kashshisha, amar leh: "hahu gavra may tehve aleh?" amar leh: "zil keni kechad mibbera". hanach – vadday la kanu, deakkatti letanhu.

Hay – it chulak letalya bimkom benayya, o let leh chulak letalya bimkom benayya? rabbi avin verabbi meyaysha verabbi yirmeya deamri: it chulak letalya bimkom benayya. rabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi yitzchak nappacha deamri: let chulak letalya bimkom benayya.

Amar leh rabbi avahu lerabbi yirmeya: hilcheta kevotan, o hilcheta kevatayychu? amar leh: peshita dehilcheta kevotan – dekashshishna minnayychu, velav hilcheta kevotayychu – dedardeke attun. amar leh: midde bekashshishuta talya milleta?! betama talya milleta! vetama may? zil legabbeh derabbi avin – deasbarta nihaleh,

a: Vecharkesh bah resheh be midresha. azal legabbeh, amar leh: illu amar leh "keni kachamor", mi kane?!
Deittemar: "keni kachamor" – lo kana. "at vachamor" – rav nachman amar: kana mechetza, verav hamenuna amar: lo amar kelum. verav sheshet amar: kana hakkol.
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la? detanya, rabbi yose omer: en lecha mar bakkishshut, ella penimi shebbo. lefichach, keshehu torem – mosif al hachitzon shebbo, vetorem.
Ammay? "at vachamor" hu!
Shane hatam, demiddeorayyta teruma meallayyta hi –

Deamar rabbi ila: minnayin lattorem min hara al hayyafe – shetterumato teruma? shenneemar: "velo tisu alav chet, baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu" – veim eno kadosh, nesiut chet lamma? mikkan lattorem min hara al hayyafe, shetterumato teruma.

Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe, metiv rav avya teyuveta: maase bechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot, velikket echad kalkala shel teenim – veshellahen hayta, veshel sheviit hayta; veamar: "hare kullechen mekuddashot li bechalkalla zot"; vekibbela achat mehen al yede kullan. amru chachamim: en achayot mekuddashot.
Achayot hu deen mekuddashot – ha nachriyyot mekuddashot; veammay? "at vachamor" hi!
Amar leh: hayeynu dachazay rav huna bar avya bechelma – demotev rav avya teyuveta. lav mi okemna deamar: "haruya mikkem levia titkaddesh li"?

Hahu daamar la lidvethu: "nichsayy lich velivnich", amar rav yosef: kanta mechetza. veamar rav yosef: mena amena la? detanya, rabbi omer: "vehayta leaharon ulevanav" – mechetza leaharon mechetza levanav.
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama hatam, aharon bar chalukka hu; lehachi perat beh rachamana – lemishkal palga. ishsha – lav bat yerushsha hi, dayya shettittol keechad min habbanim.

Ini?! veha ovada hava binhardea, veagbeya shemuel palga! bitverya, veagbeya rabbi yochanan palga! vetu, ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef, amar: hahu deme chelila dishdo deve malka aabbule veaisteruge, amar rabbi: nittevu abbule palga veisteruge palga!

Hachi hasheta?! hatam, meikkara ki havo katvi – aabbule havo katvi; veisteruge havo mesayyeyi bahadayyhu, veyada malka dahavo ka mesayyeyi; hasheta may deka katvi aabbule veaisteruge, lememra dehane palga vehane palga.
Metiv rabbi zera: haomer "hare alay mincha mea issaron, lehavi bishne chelim" – mevi shishshim bichli echad, vearbaim bichli echad.
b: Veim hevi chamishshim bichli echad vachamishshim bichli echad – yatza. im hevi in – lechattechilla la; vei salka datach kol ki hay gavvna palga ufalga hu, afillu lechattechilla name!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, anan sahadi dehay gavra meikkara – lekorban gadol ka mechavven, vehay dekaamar bishne chelim – deyada dela efshar leetoye bichli echad; kamma deefshar leetoye mayytinan.
Vehilcheta kevoteh derav yosef besade, inyan umechetza.

Hahu deshaddar piske deshirae leveteh. amar rabbi amme: haruyin levanim – labbanim, reuyin levanot – labbanot. vela amaran ella delet leh kallata, aval it leh kallata – lechallateh shaddar. vei benateh la nesivan – la shavak benateh umeshaddar lechallateh.

Hahu daamar lehu: "nichsayy livnayy". hava leh bera uveratta. mi karu inashe livra "benayy" – ulesalloke livratta meissur kaate; o dilma, la karu inashe livra "benayy" – ulemoshchah levarta bemattana kaate?

Amar abbaye, ta shema: "uvene dan – chushim". amar leh rava, dilma kidtana deve chizkiyya: shehayu merubbin kechushim shel kane! ella amar rava: "uvene fallu – eliav". rav yosef amar: "uvene etan – azarya".

Hahu daamar lehu: "nichsay livnay". hava leh bera, uvar bera. karu inashe levar bera "bera", o la? rav chaviva amar: karu inashe levar bera "bera", mar bar rav ashe amar: la karu inashe levar bera "bera". tanya kevoteh demar bar rav ashe: hammuddar hanaa mibbanim – muttar bivne vanim.

Mishna hinniach banim gedolim uketannim; hishbichu gedolim et hannechasim – hishbichu laemtza. im amru: "reu ma shehinniach abba, hare anu osin veochlim" – hishbichu leatzman. vechen haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim – hishbicha laemtza. im amra: "reu ma shehinniach li bali, hare ani osa veochelet" – hishbicha leatzmah.
Gemara amar rav chaviva bereh derav yosef bereh derava, mishshemeh derava: lo shanu ella sheshshavchu nechasim mechamat nechasim, aval shavchu nechasim mechamat atzman – hishbichu leatzman.
Ini?! veha amar rabbi chanina: afillu lo hinniach lahem avihem ella

a: Udeyayne – hassachar laemtza. veha udeyayne, demechamat atzmo hu! shane udeyayne – delintiruta hu daavida, vaafillu ketannim name matzu menatteri la.

Amru "reu ma shehinniach abba, hare anu osin veochlin" – hishbichu leatzman. rav safra shevak avu zuze. shaklinhu, avad behu iska. ato ache, tavuhu bedina kammeh derava; amar lehu: rav safra gavra rabba hu, la shavek girseh vetarach leacharine.
Haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim – hishbicha laemtza. ishsha benichse yatme may avidta? amar rabbi yirmeya: beishsha yoreshet.
Peshita! mahu detema: kevan delav darka lemitrach, af al gav dela paresh – kemo defaresh dame, kamashma lan.
Veim amra: "reu ma shehinniach li bali, hareni osa veochelet" – hishbicha leatzmah. peshita! mahu detema: kevan dishvicha la milleta, deamri: ka tarcha kamme yatme – achole achala; ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi chanina: hammassi ishsha livno gadol babbayit – kenao. vedavka gadol, vedavka betula, vedavka ishto rishona, vedavka shehissio rishon.
Peshita, yiched lo aviv bayit vaaliyyay – bayit kana, aliyyay lo kana. bayit veachsadra, mahu? shene vattim ze lifnim mizze, mahu? teku.

Metivi: yiched lo aviv bayit uchele vayit – kele vayit kana, bayit lo kana! amar rabbi yirmeya: kegon shehaya otzaro shel aviv munnach sham. nehardae amri: afillu shovacha deyone. rav yehuda verav pappe amri: afillu atzitza deharsana. mar zutera anseveh livreh, utela leh sandala. rav ashe anseveh livreh, utela leh ashisha demishcha.

Amar mar zutera, hane telat mille shavvinhu rabbanan kehilcheta bela tama: chada – ha, iddach – deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkotev kol nechasav leishto – lo asaah ella appotroppa. iddach – deamar rav: mane li beyadcha, tenehu lifloni; bemaamad shelashtan – kana.
b: Mishna achin hashshuttafin shennafal echad mehen leummanut – nafal laemtza. chala venitrappe – nitrappe mishshel atzmo.
Gemara tana: hay ummanut – leummanut hammelech. tanu rabbanan: echad min haachin shemminnuhu gabbay o pulemostus; im mechamat haachin – laachin, im mechamat atzmo – leatzmo.
Im mechamat achin laachin – peshita! la tzericha, decharif tefe; mahu detema: churepeh garem leh, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: echad min haachin shennatal matayim zuz lilmod tora o lilmod ummanut – yecholin haachin lomar lo: im atta etzlenu – yesh lecha mezonot, im en atta etzlenu – en lecha mezonot.
Velittevu leh kol hecha deiteh! mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar rav huna: birkat habbayit berubba. velittevu leh lefi birkat habbayit! hachi name.

Chala venitrappe – nitrappe mishshel atzmo. shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi ila: lo shanu ella shechala bifshia, aval beones – nitrappe min haemtza. hechi dame bifshia? kidrabbi chanina – deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim, chutz mitztzinnim pachim; shenneemar: "tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh, shomer nafsho yirchak mehem".

Mishna haachin sheasu miktzatan shoshvinut bechayye haav, chazra shoshvinut – chazra laemtza; shehashshoshvinut nigbet bevet din. aval hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen – en nigbin bevet din, mippene shehen gemilut chasadim.

Gemara ureminhi: shalach lo aviv shoshvinut, keshehi chozeret – chozeret lo. nishtallecha leaviv shoshvinut, keshehi chozeret – chozeret min haemtza. amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: ki tenan name matnitin, nishtallecha leaviv tenan.
Veha "achin sheasu miktzatan shoshvinut" katane! teni: "lemiktzatan". veha "chazra shoshvinut" katane! hachi kaamar: chazra ligbot – nigbet meemtza.
Rabbi assi amar: la kashya; kan bistam, kan bimfaresh – kidtanya: shalach lo aviv shoshvinut, keshehi chozeret – chozeret lo. shalach aviv shoshvinut setam, keshehi chozeret – chozeret laemtza.
Ushemuel amar: hacha beyavam askinan, sheeno notel barauy kivmuchezak.
Mikkelal deiddach – meshallem? lema: "tenu li shoshvini veesmach immo"!

Mi la tanya: makom shennahagu lehachezir kiddushin – machzirin, makom shennahagu shello lehachezir – en machzirin. veamar rav yosef bar abba amar mar ukeva amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shemmeta hi, aval met hu – en machzirin, may tama? yechola hi shettomar:

a: "Tenu li bali veesmach immo". hacha name, nema: "tenu li shoshvini veesmach immo"!
Amar rav yosef: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shessamach immo shiva yeme mishte, velo hispik leforo ad shemmet.

Lema "tenu li bali veesmach immo" – tannae hi? detanya: hameares et haishsha; betula – gova matayim, vealmana – mane. makom shennahagu lehachezir kiddushin – machzirin, makom shennahagu shello lehachezir kiddushin – en machzirin, divre rabbi natan. rabbi yehuda hannasi omer, beemet amru: makom shennahagu lehachezir – machzirin, makom shennahagu shello lehachezir – en machzirin.
Rabbi yehuda hannasi hayeynu tanna kamma! ella lav "tenu li bali veesmach immo" ikka benayyhu –

Vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hameares et haishsha, betula – gova matayim, vealmana – mane. bamme devarim amurim – dahadar beh ihu; aval meta – makom shennahagu lehachezir, machzirin; makom shennahagu shello lehachezir, en machzirin. vedavka shemmeta hi, aval met hu – en machzirin. may tama? yechola hi shettomar: "tenu li bali veesmach immo".

Vaata rabbi yehuda hannasi lememar, beemet amru: ben met hu, uven meta hi; makom shennahagu lehachezir – machzirin, makom shennahagu shello lehachezir – en machzirin; vela matzya amra: "tenu li bali veesmach immo"!

La; dechulle alma yechola shettomar: "tenu li bali veesmach immo". udemit hu – kulle alma la peligi, ki peligi – shemmeta hi; vehacha bekiddushin letibbuin nittenu ka mippalgi – rabbi natan savar: kiddushin lav letibbuin nittenu, verabbi yehuda hannasi savar: kiddushin letibbuin nittenu.
Veha "makom shennahagu lehachezir machzirin" katane! hachi kaamar: vesivlonot – vadday makom shennahagu lehachezir, machazirin.

Vehane tannae – kehane tannae, detanya: kiddeshah bechikkar – betula gova matayim, vealmana mane; divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: betula gova matayim, vealmana mane; umachzeret lo et hashshear. rabbi yose omer: kiddeshah beesrim – noten lah sheloshim chatzain. kiddeshah bishloshim – noten lah esrim chatzain.

Bemay askinan? ilema shemmeta, mi it la ketubba?! veella shemmet hu – ammay machzeret lo et hashshear? venema: "tenu li bali veesmach immo"! veella beeshet yisrael shezzinneta. uvemay? i beratzon – mi it la ketubba? veella beones – mishre sharya leh!

Veella beeshet kohen shenneensa, uvekiddushin letibbuin nittenu kamippalgi – rabbi meir savar: kiddushin letibbuin nittenu, verabbi yehuda savar: lav letibbuin nittenu. verabbi yose – mesappeka leh i letibbuin nittenu i la,
Vehilkach kiddeshah beesrim – noten lah sheloshim chatzain. kiddeshah bishloshim – noten lah esrim chatzain.

Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: bechol makom shennahagu lehachezir – machzirin. vetarguma: nehardea. shear bavel may? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: muhere hadri, kiddushe la hadri. amar rav pappa, hilcheta: ben shemmet hu, ben shemmeta hi, vahadar beh hu – muhere hadri, kiddushe la hadri. hadara bah ihi – afillu kiddushe name hadri.
Ammemar amar: kiddushe la hadri, gezera shemma yomru kiddushin tofsin baachotah. rav ashe amar: gittah mochiach aleha. veha derav ashe beduta hi, deikka deshama beha vela shama beha.
Shehashshoshvinut nigbet bevet din. tanu rabbanan, chamishsha devarim neemru beshoshvinut: nigbet bevet din, vechozeret beonatah, veen bah mishshum ribbit,
b: Veen hashsheviit meshammattah, veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim.
Nigbet bevet din – may tama? kemilve damya. veen bah mishshum ribbit – delav addata dehachi yehav leh. veen hashsheviit meshammattah – dela karena beh: "lo yiggos".
Veen habbechor notel pi shenayim – dehave leh rauy, veen habbechor notel barauy kivmuchezak.
Amar rav kahana, kelala deshoshvinuta: hava bemata – ibbei leh lemete. shema kal tavla – ibbei leh lemete. la shema kal tavla – ibbei leh leodoeh; taromet it leh, shallome meshallem.
Vead kamma? amar abbaye: nahagu bene genana, ad zuza – ayyeyte bechappeh achleh bichreseh. ad arbea – meshallem palga. mikkan veelach – inish inish kachashivuteh.

Tanu rabbanan: asa immo befumebe, uvikkesh laasot immo betzina – yachol lomar lo: befumebe eese immecha, kederech sheasita immi. asa immo bivtula, uvikkesh laasot immo bealmana – yachol lomar lo: bivtula eese immecha, kederech sheasita immi.

Asa immo bashsheniyya, uvikkesh laasot immo barishona – yachol lomar lo: lichshettissa ishsha acheret, eese immecha. asa immo beachat, uvikkesh laasot immo bishtayim – yachol lomar lo: beachat eese immecha, kederech sheasita immi.

Tanu rabbanan: attir nichsin attir pumebe – ze hu baal haggadot. attir selaim attir tekoa – zehu baal pilpul. attir meshach attir kemas – zehu baal shemuot. hakkol tzerichin lemare chittayya – talmud.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav, may dichtiv: "kol yeme ani raim"? ze baal talmud. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze baal mishna.

Rava amar: ippecha. vehayeynu deamar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava, may dichtiv: "massia avanim yeatzev bahem, bokea etzim yissachen bam"? "massia avanim yeatzev bahen" – ellu bale mishna. "bokea etzim yissachen bam" – ellu bale talmud.

Rabbi chanina amar: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze sheyyesh lo ishsha raa. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze sheyyesh lo ishsha tova. rabbi yannay amar: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze istenis. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze sheddato yafa.

Rabbi yochanan amar: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze rachman. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze achzari. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze sheddato ketzara. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze sheddato rechava.

a: Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "kol yeme ani raim"?! veha ikka shabbatot veyamim tovim! kedishmuel – deamar shemuel: shinnuy veset – techillat choli.
Ketiv besefer ben sira: kol yeme ani raim. ben sira omer: af lelot. bishfal gaggim gaggo, mimmetar gaggim legaggo. berum harim karmo, meafar karmo lichramim.

Mishna hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv; shalach sham mea mane, veachal sham seudat chatan afillu bedinar – enan nigbin. lo achal sham seudat chatan – hare ellu nigbin. shalach sivlonot merubbin sheyyachzeru immah levet balah – hare ellu nigbin. sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha – en nigbin.
Gemara amar rava: davka dinar, aval pachot middinar – la. peshita, dinar tenan! mahu detema: hu haddin daafillu pachot middinar, vehay dekatane dinar – orcha demilleta katane; ka mashma lan.
"Achal" tenan; shata may? "hu" tenan; shelucho may? "sham" tenan; shigger lo, may?

Ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maase beadam echad sheshshigger levet chamiv mea keronot shel kadde yayin veshel kadde shemen veshel kele chesef veshel kele zahav veshel keli melat; verachav besimchato, vehalach veamad al petach bet chamiv; vehotziu kos shel chammin veshata, umet.
Vezo halacha heela rabbi acha sar habbira lifne chachamim leusha, veamru: sivlonot haasuyin livlot – en nigbin, vesheen asuyin livlot – nigbin. shema minna: afillu shata.

Shamat minna afillu pachot middinar? amar rav ashe: man lema lan dela shachaki leh marganita deshavya alpa zuze, veashkeyu. shamat minna afillu shiggeru lo? dilma kol petach bet chamiv – kevet chamiv dame.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyeshallesh? shevach sivlonot, mahu? kevan dei itanhu – ledideh hadri, birshuteh shevuch; o dilma, kevan dei avdi o migganvi – bae shallome leh, birshuta dida shevuch? teku.

Bae rava: sivlonot haasuyin livlot, velo balu, mahu? ta shema: vezo halacha heela rabbi acha sar habbira lifne chachamim beusha, veamru: sivlonot haasuyin livlot – en nigbin, vesheen asuyin livlot – nigbin. may, lav af al gav delo balu? la, devalu.
Ta shema: sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen, vehi bevet aviha – en nigbin! targema rava: beyeva usevachta.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam echad sheshshigger levet chamiv yayin chadash veshemen chadash uchele pishtan chadash baatzeret. may ka mashma lan? ibbaet ema: chashivuta deeretz yisrael ka mashma lan, veibbaet ema: dei taen, taanteh taana.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam echad sheamru lo ishto totranit hi, venichnas achareha lechureba levodkah, amar lah: reach tzenon ani meriach baggalil.
b: Amara leh: min yahev lan mikkotavot diricho veachalna beh. nefal ala chureba, umeta. amru chachamim: hoil velo nichnas achareha ella levodkah, meta – eno yorshah.

Sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha vechulei. yatev ravin sava kammeh derav pappa, veyatev vekaamar: ben shemmeta hi uven shemmet hu, hadar hu – sivlonot hadri, maachol umishte la hadar. hadra bah ihi – hadra afillu kishsha deyarka. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: veshamin lahen deme vasar bezol. ad kamma "bezol"? ad tilta.
Mishna shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim, veshiyyer karka kol shehu – mattenato kayyemet. lo shiyyer karka kol shehu – en mattenato kayyemet.

Gemara man tena deazlinan batar umedana? amar rav nachman: rabbi shimon ben menasya hi. detanya: hare shehalach beno limdinat hayyam, veshama shemmet beno, veamad vechatav kol nechasav leacher, veachar kach ba beno – mattenato mattana. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: en mattenato mattana, sheilmale haya yodea shebbeno kayyaym – lo haya kotvan.

Rav sheshet amar: rabbi shimon shezuri hi – detanya, barishona hayu omrim: hayyotze bekolar, veamar: "kitvu get leishti" – hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar: af hamefaresh vehayyotze bishyayra. rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af hamesukkan.
Verav nachman – may tama la mokem la kerabbi shimon shezuri? shane hatam, deamar "kitvu". verav sheshet – may tama la mokem la kerabbi shimon ben menasya? umedana demochach shane.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: hare shehaya chole umutal bammitta, veamru lo: nechasecha lemi? veamar lahen:
